verdict.rationale: Adyen's evidence shows only narrow, domain-specific scheduling: merchants can configure payout frequency per merchant account, and the MCP server's Management API tools include scheduling terminal actions. Nothing shows general-purpose scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: a general scheduler for user-defined recurring jobs/workflows, API or agent-driven creation and management of scheduled workflows, run history and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
